decision.rationale: action-2 staggered RMSE 0.081C and action-3 alternate RMSE 0.072C show no_mismatch_observed on those inputs only, which does not certify unseen schedules; candidate training RMSE sensor_lag 0.083C vs linear/quadratic 0.374C on initial-0,1,2 is fitting only and cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy; propose sustained-both diagnostic to test initial model on new input within remaining budget. Proposal does not run experiment.
